cover.role: Editorial cover; decorative schematic rather than a quantitative chart
cover.prompt:
Use case: editorial-illustration
Asset type: 16:9 Chinese technical blog cover, wide landscape 1792x1024 or closest exact 16:9 output.
Primary request: A refined minimalist technical editorial illustration about Gini as a predictive model ranking metric. Off-white background, five clean rounded user profile cards lined up from left to right, with abstract coin/value marks diminishing from high to low, and an elegant cumulative gains chart behind and above them: a blue polygonal concave rising curve from bottom left to top right above a thin gray diagonal, with a very subtle translucent blue area between the curve and diagonal. The curve and diagonal share endpoints, like a cumulative value concentration chart. The cards are understated small secondary visual elements, the chart is the central visual. A small tasteful title reading exactly 'Gini' in dark navy, no other text or axis labels. Flat precise geometry with faint soft dimensional shading, generous negative space, restrained blue/teal palette, sophisticated magazine quality, visually coherent and uncluttered. No laptops, books, dashboards, dense text, formulas, fake numbers, logos or watermark. Full composition safely inside generous margins.
